price_source.service: Vertex AI (Cloud Billing services/C7E2-9256-1C43), the service the app's Vertex client is billed under
price_source.mode: standard online text (OnDemand, resource group AiPlatform); not flex, batch, priority or cached
price_source.unit: unitPrice.nanos per token; USD per 1k tokens = nanos / 1e6 (1500 nanos input, 7500 nanos output for both models)
price_source.note: Thinking tokens are billed as output tokens. The Gemini API service (AEFD-7695-64FA) lists 750/3750 nanos for the same model names; that is the Developer API product, not the Vertex endpoint this app calls, so it is NOT used.
price_source.recheck_at_switch: SW38, two separate things. (1) WARNING: price_snapshot_status() reports stale/future/undated after price_snapshot_max_age_days; the held-out budget preflight (check_budget_config) fails visibly on it, before any provider call. (2) CHECK: comparing these prices with the CURRENT provider price (Cloud Billing catalog) is NOT automated and NOT available offline; a person or a task must do it at the moment the extraction role is switched to gemini-3.8-flash, then update price_snapshot_date. The 2026-09-30 snapshot has not been re-checked by this change; no price here was changed.
price_source.sw38_worst_case: per call 24000 x 0.0015/1k + 12288 x 0.0075/1k = 0.12816 (thinking counted as output inside max_output_tokens); per job at max_retries 1 and 1 call: 0.25632 < per_job_cap 0.30 (margin 0.04368). Admission reserves at the priciest configured model; total_cap_usd is unchanged (its cap_basis already priced every call at the 3.8-class worst call).
price_source.cap_basis: 560 provider-calling jobs (F2 landed) x 2 attempts x worst call (24000 x 0.0015/1k + 12288 x 0.0075/1k = 0.12816) = 143.54; 185.00 = 143.54 + 10 percent + the T04 reserve requested by TESTER
